name: Pane session
responsibility: One pane's contact with the server: holds the vault and repository the server put it in, and names that vault on its socket, reports, readings and calls
description: pane-arrival adopts the vault and repository that a pane_board message names, and pane-core keeps them as a mirror of the server. pane-socket opens the socket with ?vault= and socket-messages routes each message. A report is keyed by its vault, so the server answers one naming a vault the pane left with registered:false. Canonical reports preserve architecture metadata when the legacy board is null. The request names the admitted pane vault, while architecture names the actual reading vault. Explanation controls wait for pane registration. A tab-scoped explanation notice invalidates the existing answer query. The existing socket connector names canonical pane intent on each connection. The browser continues to own the exact model address.

outgoing.label: reports, readings and calls, each naming the pane's vault
